w5_ledger_entry.prompt: A single seamless tileable orthographic material texture: moss-green wool and linen upholstery cloth in a visible fine plain over-under weave, a square covering exactly 0.25 metre across. Muted natural moss green, restrained fibre colour variation and a slight irregular slub, coherent fine yarn spacing suitable for a chair cushion. Uniform diffuse base colour (albedo) only, delighted flat full-frame swatch. Both opposite edge pairs join continuously when repeated in a grid, including warp and weft spacing at top/bottom and left/right. No decorative pattern, no print, no embroidery, no seam, no stitching, no folds, no perspective, no directional lighting, no specular highlights, no baked shadows, no vignette or exposure gradient, no labels, no text or border. One square tile, uniformly detailed to every edge; suitable for a final 512x512 texture.
